football_ontology.switch_of_play: Cross-field pass that shifts the ball laterally across the pitch (>=20m width change, e.g. from one wing/half-space to the opposite flank).
football_ontology.long_ball: Pass or distribution traveling >=25m (approx. 28+ yards) across the pitch.
football_ontology.long_ball_switch: Long cross-field pass (>=25m total distance and >=20m lateral width shift) switching play from one wing to the other.
football_ontology.progressive_pass: Completed pass that advances the ball >=10m closer to the opponent's goal or into the penalty box.
football_ontology.line_breaking_pass: Completed forward pass (>=7m vertical advance) that bypasses at least two opponent defenders/midfielders.
football_ontology.through_ball: Forward pass into open space behind the defensive line received by a teammate running at >=18 km/h.
football_ontology.cross: Wide delivery from the flank or byline into the penalty area.
football_ontology.cutback: Pass pulled back from near the byline/deep wide box toward the penalty spot or Zone 14.
football_ontology.key_pass: Pass that directly sets up a teammate's shot attempt within 6 seconds.
football_ontology.on_ball_dribble: Active ball carry where the player drives with the ball at their feet.
football_ontology.progressive_carry: On-ball dribble/carry that advances the ball >=5m closer to the opponent's goal.
football_ontology.on_ball_1v1_duel: Direct 1v1 confrontation where the attacker HAS POSSESSION OF THE BALL and engages a defender within <=6.5m.
football_ontology.optimal_shot: Shot taken with a clear goal corridor and high angle where no teammate had a significantly higher-probability open pass lane.
football_ontology.suboptimal_shot: Shot taken into blockers or from a worse angle/distance while a teammate was open in a superior scoring position with a clear pass lane.
football_ontology.half_space: Interior vertical channel between the wide wing and central corridor (y in [14m..25m] or [43m..54m]).
football_ontology.zone_14: Central creative zone directly in front of the opponent penalty box (x in [70m..88m], y in [22m..46m]).
football_ontology.overlap: Outside run made by a teammate (typically a fullback) around the wide side of the ball carrier in the attacking half.
football_ontology.high_press_front_aggression: High Pressing Block where the defensive line is pushed high into midfield (>=40m from own goal) with an aggressive attacking frontline compressing opponent build-up.
football_ontology.compact_mid_block: Balanced tactical mid-block with synchronized dual banks, holding the middle third with tight vertical separation between defense and midfield (<14m).
football_ontology.deep_low_block: Deep Low-Block penalty box defense (defensive line <=28m from own goal) packing central defensive zones.
football_ontology.positional_possession_expansion: Positional possession expansion where the team stretches pitch width (>=48m) and length with touchline wingers and inverted fullbacks.
football_ontology.counter_attack_rest_defense: Counter-attack transition structure with frontline breaking into space while rest-defense unit remains stationed behind the ball.
football_ontology.asymmetric_flank_overload: Asymmetric structural overload shifting the team centroid >=7.5m laterally towards one flank to isolate the opposite winger.
football_ontology.defensive_line_height: Average distance (in meters) of the back four/defensive line from their own goal line.
football_ontology.midfield_gap: Vertical separation (in meters) between the defensive backline and the midfield unit.
football_ontology.attacking_frontline_width: Lateral dispersion (in meters) of the attacking forward line across the pitch.
football_ontology.total_block_depth: Overall vertical distance (in meters) from the deepest outfield defender to the furthest forward attacker.
football_ontology.aerial_cross_into_box: Lofted pass or cross delivered high into the opponent penalty box bypassing ground defenders.
football_ontology.dangerous_box_run: High-speed sprint (>=17 km/h) penetrating directly into the 18-yard penalty box into dangerous goal-scoring areas.

learned_preferences: Prioritize non-standard coaching metrics: pass providers on runs, overlap timing, primary markers, and sub-optimal shot audits.
